# Native theme-color extrema neighbors

Original manually authored OOXML, generated by
`tools/theme_minmax_neighbors_fixture.py` using this repository's empty table
scaffold. No corpus text, artwork, third-party engine, or font binary is included
in the source. Two parent colors and their six one-byte RGB neighbors each have
13 shade and 13 tint controls: 208 cases, including 16 neutral FF modifiers.
The three columns exercise themed text, fill, and border attributes with an
intentionally incorrect `112233` fallback.

On 2026-10-04, the unique authored source was opened in the reference application
using the reference-application opener. Native Save As PDF, Standard quality, produced `w.pdf`;
it was renamed locally to `native.pdf`. The owned source window was then closed.
The source SHA-256 before opening and after closing is identical:
`71df1ca639389d02dfee1986b90af35ed0b131475ee9c305d3d595d4db651dd2`.
A second generator run reproduces exactly the source and case inventory.

`reference.json` records all 208 native **text** colors on six pages using
PDFium's text fill-color API, independently of this renderer. It binds the
source, cases, and PDF by SHA-256. No saved reference DOCX was captured. The initial
record contains text colors; the subsequent `check-theme-color-contexts.py`
diagnostic independently confirms matching native fill/border colors for all
208 rows.
The native PDF is an export of our own authored controls, not a corpus export.

Reproduce the extraction with:

```text
python tools/record_theme_boundary_colors.py tests/fixtures/theme-minmax-neighbors --source theme-minmax-neighbors-20261004.docx
python tools/check_theme_minmax_neighbors.py
python -m unittest discover -s tools -p "test_theme_*.py"
```

All 32 inputs overlapping previous native controls agree (26 shades and six
tints). The holdout adds 176 new inputs: 156 neighbor observations and 20 parent
tints. They remain separate from the original 2176-row study. This evidence
rejects proposed intermediate rounding stages.
The later branch-coupled integer converter matches this holdout and the other
native color families. Full layout remains uncertified: the reference application fits 36 rows per
page in this source, while the viewer currently fits 35. The color browser
test samples viewer row centers and makes no native pagination claim.
